cause: Q4/FY23 call (Mar 19) showed power costs beating plan ($0.032/kWh 2023), aggressive debt paydown ($40M in 4 months, another $30M planned in April), a new HPC/AI hosting pivot narrative (300MW available at Lake Mariner, 2MW pilot underway), and management pitched the stock as trading at 6x 2024 EBITDA vs peer average 9x/14-16x - a valuation-gap re-rating story
quality: 混合: debt paydown and power-cost execution are real and durable, but the AI/HPC hosting business is still just a 2MW pilot (no signed hyperscaler contracts yet) and post-halving all-in cost per Bitcoin rises to a guided $37,000, meaning miner-side economics get materially tighter
reason: Unlike several other names in this set, WULF was NOT already extended going into the print (21d -1.69%, 63d +28.73%), so this reads more like a fresh re-rating than a chase into an already-parabolic move. Real balance sheet improvement (net working capital swung from -$60M to +$31M) and a credible cheap-valuation-vs-peers argument support continuation, but the HPC/AI angle is unproven (pilot-stage only) and should be treated as optionality, not a confirmed pivot.
red_flags: 2023年通过ATM增发5800万股(均价$2.05),稀释性融资;减半后每枚比特币全成本上升至指引的$37,000,若币价不配合利润率承压;HPC/AI托管业务仅为2MW试点,尚无大型hyperscaler签约
